subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

In industries, it is very common to observe that people show __undue favour to one’s own relative during the hiring process__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"nepotism"** refers to showing favoritism or undue preference to one’s relatives, especially in professional or employment settings. (भाई-भतीजावाद)

 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of nepotism after hiring his cousin for a senior role despite a lack of qualifications.
 
 
 
• This accurately describes the practice mentioned in the question.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 1 - Nepotism**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 - Racism:** (जातिवाद) Refers to prejudice or discrimination based on race or ethnicity.

 
 
• **Example:** The organization was criticized for racism after multiple complaints from minority employees.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - Liberalism:** (उदारवाद) Refers to a political and moral philosophy advocating for freedom, equality, and civil rights.
 
 
• **Example:** Liberalism promotes the idea of a free market and individual freedoms.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - Communism:** (साम्यवाद) Refers to a political theory advocating for classless society and common ownership of production means.
 
 
• **Example:** Communism was a dominant ideology in several countries during the 20th century.
